summary: Stand up emoji-runtime ingestion, monitoring, and lore alignment for factory-order@1.0 promotions.
context: Toyfoundry is implementing an adapter that promotes High Command emoji-runtime@1.0 payloads into factory-order@1.0. Toysoldiers must accept the promoted payloads, extend monitoring hooks, and protect lore alignment so toddler-facing narration stays in sync with field telemetry.

directives.details: Coordinate with Toyfoundry on order-2025-11-01-040 to understand adapter rollout timeline, sample payload pack, and any schema nuances.

Modify consumer pipeline to accept factory-order@1.0 payloads produced from emoji-runtime sources. Ensure glyph_chain, spoken prompts, and intent metadata remain accessible for narration/AI planning layers.
Instrument telemetry to detect schema drift, narration mismatches, and outcome taxonomy issues. Create lightweight dashboards/alerts that surface discrepancies back to High Command and War Office.

Run end-to-end test: consume Toyfoundry's promoted payloads, execute simulation/field drills, and ensure responses can be translated back into emoji-runtime summaries for Alfa 04 playback. Capture logs showing success and edge cases.
Submit report to exchange/reports/inbox/order-2025-11-01-041-report.json documenting ingestion changes, monitoring coverage, test evidence, and any follow-up requests for High Command or R&D.

success_criteria: Factory-order@1.0 payloads promoted from emoji-runtime sources ingest without errors
Monitoring hooks raise alerts for schema drift or narration mismatches
Round-trip emoji narration verified with sample payloads
Completion report logged with evidence and next steps

attachments.description: Toyfoundry adapter order for coordinated rollout

safety_notes: Coordinate go-live windows with Toyfoundry to avoid ingesting partially promoted payloads
Keep historical payloads for replay until monitoring confirms stability
Loop War Office if narration cues deviate from lore canon
